name: OPT-NC DC Nouville (CITIUS)
developer: OPT-NC (Office des Postes et Télécommunications de Nouvelle-Calédonie; CITIUS subsidiary)
notes: Operational OPT-NC server/data facility at DC Nouville, 1 Rue Contre-Amiral Joseph du Bouzet, Nouville (Nouméa, Province Sud), historically operated by CITIUS (OPT-NC subsidiary since 2008). OPT-NC official release (2023-10-18) states the DC Nouville site hosts the data center, accounts for ~4.5% of OPT-NC electricity consumption, and received 276 solar panels (124 kWp); DCD independently reported the same operational site. No IT load or MW capacity disclosed.

name: DSP DC1-MGTA
notes: DSP (dsp.nc official site) states it is a 100% privately owned Nouméa-based company and the only actor in New Caledonia operating 2 data centers. Service brochure identifies first site as DC1-MGTA dedicated to production; DataCenterMap lists DSP DC1 at 210 rue Gervolino, Nouméa with ~20 racks. No MW capacity disclosed. Re-verified via dsp.nc and PeeringDB AS134405.

name: DSP DC2-GAL
notes: DSP brochure identifies second site as DC2-GAL for PRA/PCA disaster-recovery services; DataCenterMap lists DSP DC2 at 34 rue du général GALLIENI, Nouméa with ~6 racks. No MW capacity disclosed. Re-verified via dsp.nc official site.

name: DSP second data center extension
notes: Groupe CIPAC (local business network) 2025 article reports DSP is extending its second data center to support economic growth and growing digital needs in New Caledonia. Extension status, capacity and completion date not disclosed; treat as announced/expansion lead (B).

name: UNC/CRESICA shared computing data center (PNT)
notes: OPT-NC official news (2021-12-10) states UNC's PNT (Pôle Numérique de Nouvelle-Calédonie) has been operational since the 2019 academic year, with a data center/server room installed at UNC Nouville and high-performance computing servers being installed; OPT-NC sponsors a 10 Gbps leased link between UNC Nouville and IRD Ansa Vata. Academic/research computing facility, not commercial colocation. No MW capacity disclosed.

name: Stratos Tier 3 data center Mont-Dore
notes: Operator page (checked 2026-08-12): dedicated Tier 3-principle data center at Mont-Dore (Grand Nouméa, Province Sud), operated by local team, N+1 electrical redundancy with dual Enercal feeds, UPS, diesel generator 72h+ autonomy, dual cooling groups, VESDA detection, inert-gas fire suppression, biometric/physical security, multi-FAI peering (OPT, MLS, Lagoon, Citius) with direct Gondwana-1 access. Colocation from 1U to cages, managed hosting, IaaS. 'Tier 3' is self-attested via internal annual audit, no formal Uptime Institute certification. No MW capacity disclosed.

name: Exodata Nouméa data center (myCloud)
notes: Exodata cloud page lists Nouméa, New Caledonia data center for local cloud presence; 2022-12-19 company post says Exodata operated in Nouméa since 2017 and acquired myCloud (5th acquisition), a datacenter-autonomous specialist; Open NC member profile lists address 1 rue Laguimiville VDC, 98800 Nouméa, ISO 27001 certified, HDS health-data host, operating datacenters in France/DOM/COM including NC; NeoTech.nc interview with managing partner Benjamin Forte corroborates. No MW capacity disclosed.

name: my::NET interconnected data centers
notes: my::NET official site (mynet.nc) confirms hosting solutions for enterprises; OPEN NC profile says my::NET, founded 2018, operates three interconnected data centers 100% in New Caledonia for sovereign cloud/IaaS/SaaS/PaaS, storage, backup, virtualization, compute and cybersecurity. Facility names, addresses and MW capacity not disclosed; grade B (operator + business-association profiles, no permit/energy records).

name: ART Cloud localized IBM data center
notes: ART Informatique official page (checked 2026-08-12) markets ART Cloud hosting in New Caledonia 'dans un Datacenter IBM de niveau 3+' with availability above 99.98%; ART Informatique based at 15 rue Edouard Glasser, 98803 Nouméa. Facility is operator-marketed as a localized IBM level-3+ datacenter; no separate facility address or MW capacity disclosed; existence graded A (operator claim), 'IBM level 3+' classification not independently certified.

name: Felix Datacenter
notes: Open-map-derived listings identify Felix Datacenter at 5 Rue Felix Broche, Nouméa, operator/owner shown as Nautile, creation date 2021-01-01. Treated as weak evidence (map/aggregate listings only, no operator or permit records found); no MW capacity disclosed.
